Inspection / Maintenance Item: Are all fittings that are subject to container pressure rated for at least 250 psig working pressure?
Are all unused openings plugged or capped?
Are pressure gauges in good condition and suitable for 250 psig service (such as 0 - 400 psig)?
Are liquid level gauges arranged and installed so that the liquid level can be accurately determined?
Is the relief valve marked for use with LP- Gas and labeled by an independent testing agency?
Is the relief capacity sufficient, as determined by NFPA 58?
Do relief valves communicate with the container vapor space and discharge upward, unobstructed to the open air?
Are relief valves on containers >2000 gallons water capacity equipped with vent stacks of proper diameter and length?
Are relief valve vent stacks on containers >2000 gallons water capacity equipped with breakaway couplings?
Do relief valves or vent stacks have loose- fitting protective caps or closures to prevent entry of foreign matter?
Are weep holes for moisture drainage open and is gas impingement of the container prevented?
